title: ArcEvents fishing expedition v2 session-credit balance
assumptions: The before state has no fishing-session currency or shop. The after state is the new v2 temporary match economy; its integer credits are scoped to one match and are discarded at match end, with no Vault, premium-token, EMC, item-export or XP redemption.

A completed run defeats 3 normal creatures on each of 5 islands (15 total), sells all normal catches, defeats each boss once, and buys one standard progression kit. All actions are successful; no deaths, skipped encounters, external rewards, refunds or coin-cap effects are modeled.

Normal catch values use saleBase=10, salePerStage=6, rareEvery=7 and rareMultiplier=3. The 15 catches sell for 442 credits because catches 7 and 14 are rare. The five boss rewards total 550 credits. Each completed run therefore emits 992 credits and the modeled standard kit consumes 958, leaving 34 within that run.

Low/base/high activity is 0.25/1/2 completed runs per active participant-day. Participants [1,10,50] are hypothetical eligible players, not observed telemetry. No shared network pool or durable savings is assumed.

Standard progression kit: knife 25, pistol 80, shotgun 140, burst rifle 220, assault rifle 300, two 32-round ammo purchases at 8 each, one two-stick dynamite pack at 12, and rod upgrades 45 and 120; total 958. Full purchasable armory plus the same consumables costs 1,433. It is a choice comparison, not an additional simultaneous burn flow.

After reaching the Volcano quest target, normal catches repeat before the final boss-bait claim and trophy. Eleven additional kills sell for 442 credits under the deterministic rare cadence, enough to cover the 441-credit difference between one complete run's 992 credits and the 1,433-credit full package.

Disposable carry-over savings are zero because credits do not persist across matches. Evaluator days-to-save values are consequently null; affordability is assessed within a run, not by accumulating a durable balance across days.

flows.basis: The run sells all 15 normal catches at the configured base and rare values; 442 credits per full run under the default rules.
One reward for each of the five defeated island bosses; 50+80+110+140+170=550 credits per full run.
One modeled in-match standard progression choice per full run; its 958-credit total is listed in the assumptions.
After the modeled standard kit, the remaining 34 credits are temporary match state and are discarded when the owner releases/closes the adventure; no balance persists to the next run.
